r1.summary: Validate finite IDs at finalize and delete response boundaries
r1.fix: Decode normalized finalize/delete results with identity-annotated schemas using finite numeric ids and derived result types. Preserve missing-id defaults (upload 0; delete found.id); map invalid supplied ids to the existing malformed ArtifactError policy. Add RPC regressions for not-a-number, Infinity and 1e309 in Artifact.test.ts. Central bookkeeping records the verified upstream bug.

r2.summary: Reject line breaks in resolved tar-manifest paths
r2.fix: Before writing the manifest or invoking tar/upload, reject resolved paths containing LF or CR with ActionCacheError archiveFailed and an offending-path diagnostic. Add ActionCache.test.ts regression proving no tar/upload runs for a newline-bearing filename; record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r3.summary: Remove recursively covered descendants from the tar input manifest
r3.fix: Use an ordered prefix pass or path trie to omit paths already covered by a selected real directory that tar recursively archives. Preserve symlink behavior, meaningful ordering, and cache-version hashing of the original literal patterns. Add an archive-member regression in ActionCache.test.ts proving each covered file is stored once. Record the demonstrated upstream bug centrally.

r4.summary: Propagate the templates trailing-carriage-return refusal as a typed Result failure
r4.fix: Add trailingCarriageReturn to the public error-kind schema and prose map, then return ManagedDocumentError through Result.fail without throwing on reason translation. Handle the unreachable unknownCommentStyle invariant separately with the existing RejectedRegionDialectError contract. Add an LF-document/bare-CR regression in ManagedDocument.test.ts and record the propagation centrally.

r5.summary: Annotate all reusable cache-key constraint blocks
r5.fix: Supply identity-derived identifier, title and description on every named reusable check, including both RestoreDepth built-ins. Preserve pattern, length/range bounds, existing title, and restore-depth message. Retain/update CacheKey.test.ts assertions to cover the metadata without weakening grammar tests; any forced schema-key bookkeeping is central.

r6.summary: Annotate the reusable managed-region name grammar check
r6.fix: Pass identity-derived identifier, title and description as S.isPattern filter annotations. Preserve the pattern and field descriptions; retain/update ManagedDocument.test.ts metadata assertions.

r7.summary: Reject object-path dot segments before S3 signing and HTTP execution
r7.fix: Reject complete . and .. segments in the joined bucket/prefix/key path with a typed BlobStoreError before signing or sending. Preserve all other raw segments and existing encoding. Add BlobStore.test.ts regressions showing no HTTP execution for those paths; record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r8.fix: Bound each poll sleep by the remaining maxWait budget and flush when that budget expires, preserving quiet-window behavior and scope finalization. Add the 500ms/750ms TestClock regression in CheckDocument.test.ts; record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r9.summary: Normalize bare carriage returns inside table cells
r9.fix:
Replace CRLF, CR and LF with
using /\r\n|\r|\n/g. Add direct-table and schema-derived-table bare-CR regressions in GitHubMarkdown.test.ts; record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r10.summary: Escape unmatched link-label brackets while preserving supported inline Markdown
r10.fix: Apply bracket-aware escaping to unmatched, unescaped brackets before constructing the passthrough node, preserving supported inline Markdown. Add parser-backed regressions in GitHubMarkdown.test.ts showing the whole label belongs to one link; record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r11.summary: Give S3Config an executable schema source of truth
r11.fix: Define an identity-annotated S3Config schema and derive its same-name type, preserving all field types and explicit-undefined optional semantics. Keep constructor behavior. Add a focused new-schema round-trip property in BlobStore.property.test.ts; added-export/deviation bookkeeping is central, not a module-group README/ledger edit.

r12.summary: Use Bool.match for the dry-run orchestration decision
r12.fix: Import effect/Boolean as Bool and use Bool.match with lazy branches, preserving logging, fallback and the original disabled effect. Retain DryRun.test.ts behavior assertions; no test rewrite is required.

r13.summary: Keep complete shim targets literal in POSIX and Windows scripts
r13.fix: Encode the entire resolved POSIX target as a single-quoted literal with embedded single-quote escaping in both node-script and executable branches, retaining "$@". On Windows encode safely or reject unsupported quote/expansion/control bytes in the complete target with layoutUnexpected before any shim write, including cache-root components; do not blanket-reject Windows path separators. Add target/cache-root metacharacter regressions in PackageManagerInstaller.test.ts, preserving ordinary shim semantics. Record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r14.summary: Reject Windows device names before writing installer shims
r14.fix: When windows is true, reject reserved device stems before the first dot, case-insensitively, through layoutUnexpected before any shim write. Preserve current containment checks and POSIX accepted names. Add a Windows-only regression beside the escaping-bin cases in PackageManagerInstaller.test.ts; record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r15.fix: Use R.assignProperty or R.fromEntries to construct the bin record, preserving string-value and empty-map validation. Add a JSON own-__proto__ plus normal-bin regression in PackageManagerInstaller.test.ts; record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r16.summary: Preserve own __proto__ keys when handing off child secrets
r16.fix: Use R.assignProperty(declassified, name, plaintext), preserving the plain-record representation and masking order. Add the own-key regression in Secret.test.ts and record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r17.summary: Remove throw-to-catch JSON codec control flow and redundant identity unwraps
r17.fix: Use S.decodeEffect(Json) plus Effect.mapError for installer JSON boundaries with existing subjects/reasons/SchemaError causes. Map the JWT decodeResult failure directly to JwtPayloadFailure without throwing, preserving segment/base64url behavior and cause identity. Use Result.getOrThrow for unsignedJwt's intentionally throwing fixture encoder. Add/retain malformed-input regressions in PackageManagerInstaller.test.ts and internal/jwt.coverage.test.ts. Keep codecs and guarded unknown reads; their forced deviation record belongs centrally.

r18.summary: Terminate POSIX zip options before supplying filenames
r18.fix: Insert -- between destination and files in the POSIX argv. Update archiveCommands.test.ts command-shape assertions and add a leading-dash-path regression; preserve the Windows branch. Record the verified upstream bug centrally.

r19.summary: Construct unstubbed defects directly with Effect.die
r19.fix: Return Effect.die(UnstubbedMemberError.make({ message })) with the exact existing message and defect value. Retain callers' defect assertions; no upstream restore or module-local bookkeeping edit is needed.
